description: specs/verification-architecture.md's proof-obligation table declares PROP-5 (CRIT-001) and PROP-6 (CRIT-002) as Tier T2 = 'integration/property (no-mock)' (verification-architecture.md:27-28: 'PROP-5 | REQ-5,14 | ... | T2 | ✅' and 'PROP-6 | REQ-6 | ... | T2 | ✅'), and the tier legend explicitly defines T2 as 'integration/property (no-mock)' (verification-architecture.md:3). In practice, tests/test-prop5-failclosed-publish.sh drives gates/publish-gate.sh exclusively via ARTICLE_TEST_FORCE_V0/ARTICLE_TEST_FORCE_V05, and tests/test-prop6-modeA-draft.sh drives run.sh exclusively via ARTICLE_TEST=1 + ARTICLE_TEST_V0_RESULTS/ARTICLE_TEST_V05_RESULTS force overrides. Every code path these tests exercise short-circuits at the top of gates/v0.sh (lines 18-26) and gates/v05.sh (lines 46-56) before reaching any real logic. This is a mock (a forced, injected result standing in for the gate's actual decision procedure), not a no-mock integration test as the T2 tier designation requires. The declared verification tier for these two required (✅) proof obligations therefore does not match what is actually executed — the real fail-closed-when-unwired wiring of gates/v05.sh (the specific behavior CRIT-001's passThreshold names: 'the non-test-mode path of gates/v05.sh delegates criteria (a)-(d) to the running agent's judgment... a real run with no response present fails CLOSED') is never run by any test, only confirmed by this adversary's static read of the source.
